evals.prompt: Use $releases to create Billing August for an August 15 production release. It touches /work/billing through Azure Repos PR 482. We need smoke, migration, and rollback testing; a possible regression is duplicate invoice generation.
evals.expected_output: The agent completes the Azure CLI, extension, configuration, and authenticated-project preflight before accessing release files. After success it creates one flat Markdown record under ~/.agents/releases with status not started, ISO dates, the required sections, concrete testing and regression checkboxes, and the verified local repository and PR. It records only supplied or locally proven commits, leaving None recorded when none are established. It discovers work items live from PR 482 without storing their mutable details, appends the creation note, and reports stored facts separately from live Azure evidence.

evals.prompt: Use $releases to review all active releases and tell me what needs attention before QA or production.
evals.expected_output: After a successful Azure preflight, the agent reads flat release records, excludes released records by default, groups active releases by status, validates local repository paths and commits, refreshes every Azure Repos PR and its linked work items, and reports unchecked acceptance, testing, and regression items plus missing or inconsistent evidence. It does not modify records based on review findings.

evals.prompt: Use $releases to mark Billing August as in qa, but Azure CLI authentication is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops before reading or writing ~/.agents/releases, identifies the failed Azure authentication preflight, gives the exact manual login or configuration action needed, does not attempt login or request a token, and does not change the release status or any local file.
